notes_for_editor: Only the Dunigan record and the NRHP multiple property listing were read. Two WebSearch calls found no Middleton tower and no move. The listing's table names three Hardeman County towers (Hickory Valley, Hornsby, Kennedy) and not Middleton; I did not verify whether that table covers only surviving towers, so the story does not rely on that absence. No build date, staffing, access or destination found.
